title: Bamboo Extract for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Bamboo Extract for Hair: Silica, Silicon Research & Evidence | FullyVital
seo_description: No study tests bamboo extract on hair. Here is what trials of silicon supplements found for hair thickness and strength, and what is still unknown.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.

Merge target; redirected posts were unsourced and nothing was carried over. No hair study of bamboo extract exists in PubMed; the article says so and reports silicon (ch-OSA) trials as related research.
flags: Evidence gap: silicon trials used choline-stabilized orthosilicic acid, not bamboo; the article states this.
Barel 2005 hair result is a self-rated secondary outcome within-group; the article says so.
Both silicon trials used the same silicon form.
